en: Sepia-toned studio portrait of a young man in a suit and bow tie, leaning his arms on the back of a white chair and looking directly at the camera. At the bottom right is an embossed studio mark, and across the lower part of the image there is a large white handwritten signature reading a name similar to "Allan Matson" (exact spelling unclear). The style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard portrait.
